impact: `.wave-path-1/-2/-3` all use `animation: … infinite` on the landing page — three overlapping CSS keyframes running forever. This matches the design.md anti-pattern "looping ambient motion that distracts" and "decorative animation without meaning." Reduced-motion is honored (good), but the default state should not carry three ambient loops. Options: (a) one-shot entrance animation only, (b) a single slow wave, (c) trigger on scroll into view via IntersectionObserver. Any of these preserves the wave signature without three simultaneous loops competing for attention above the feature cards.
resolution: Committed in 321e478. Dropped `infinite` on all three .wave-path-N animations. Keyframes oscillate around the base position (0%/100% identical, 50% offset), so a single iteration lands back where it started — one gentle entrance bob per wave, then quiet. Original delays kept so the three waves stagger in. prefers-reduced-motion suppression unchanged.
title: Three infinite wave animations run simultaneously on landing
